title: Life Cycles
seo_title: Grade 2 Science: Life Cycles Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Living things have life cycles adapted to their environment: metamorphic and non-metamorphic life cycles, similarities and differences between offspring and parents, and First Peoples knowledge of life cycles (salmon). (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 2, Biology)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 science worksheets (BC): life cycles of animals and plants, metamorphosis, babies and parents, and growing up. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Living things grow and have young.
key_sub: A caterpillar changes into a butterfly.
body_html:
How to think about it

Every living thing has a life cycle.

  • A frog goes from egg to tadpole to frog.
  • A kitten grows into a cat with the same body shape.
  • Salmon hatch in rivers and grow in the ocean.
Example

What does a tadpole become?

It grows legs and loses its tail.

Answer: a frog

Example

What comes first: seed or seedling?

The seed sprouts.

Answer: seed

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all baby animals look like their parents (a caterpillar does not).
  • Leaving out the egg in a life cycle.
